description: This file defines the TaskViewModel class, which manages task data, editor state, and interactions for a task management UI in an Android application. It includes state management, data observation, and methods for creating, editing, saving, deleting, and toggling task completion.

classes.name: TaskEditorState
classes.description: A data class representing the state of the task editor, including task id, title, description, and completion status.

classes.name: TaskViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing task data and UI state, providing functions to create, edit, save, delete, and toggle completion of tasks.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Resets the editor to create a new task.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Populates the editor with an existing task for editing.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the title in the editor state.

methods.name: updateDescription
methods.description: Updates the description in the editor state.

methods.name: updateCompleted
methods.description: Updates the completed status in the editor state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current editor state as a new task or updates an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by its ID.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.
